data.title: 02 · 绘本的睡前重读
data.description: 她的房间，她蜷在床上重读那本破旧的绘本《魔物与王子》，手指轻轻抚过插图；平时闹腾的人此刻安静得像怕吵醒书里的谁。
data.action: 她的房间，她蜷在床上重读那本破旧的绘本《魔物与王子》，手指轻轻抚过插图
data.promptProse: Zero Two curls on her bed rereading the worn picture book about the monster and the prince, one finger gently tracing its illustration. Her cream sweatshirt and relaxed red trousers keep the pose quiet, pink hair resting beside the pillow. The horizontal medium view includes the open spread and bed corner. A bedside lamp illuminates the yellowed paper and her still face, with deeper book-fold shadows and soft bedding shade around her knees.
